input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: NATUURPUNT BEHEER VZW. Summary: Interreg Admire: Hydrological Restoration in the Laak Valleys. Description: Object of these works Hydrological restoration of Laakvalleien Objective of the works The intended works are part of the hydrological restoration of peat areas within the Interreg ADMIRE project. We are attempting to rehydrate the seriously dried out peat soil to stop peat degradation and enable development into a peat swamp. Background information Interreg ADMIRE: ADMIRE in general In the Interreg ADMIRE project, 10 partners in Flanders and the Netherlands work together cross-border on peatlands. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: MUNICIPALITY OF OUDSBERGEN. Summary: Drawing up a Municipal Spatial Policy Plan in Oudsbergen. Description: The municipality of Oudsbergen wants to have a new municipal spatial policy plan drawn up. This policy plan forms the strategic framework for the spatial development of Oudsbergen in the short, medium and long term. It replaces the former municipal one spatial structure plans of the former municipalities of Opglabbeek and Meeuwen-Gruitrode and offers an integrated vision of the desired spatial future of the merged municipality. The spatial policy plan will serve as a compass for municipal spatial planning policy until the year 2050. It describes the ambitions, principles and policy choices with which Oudsbergen wants to respond to current challenges such as urbanization, climate change, open space conservation, housing, mobility and economic development. In addition, special attention is paid to a sustainable, climate-neutral and child-friendly design of the living environment. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: BRUGGE. Summary: Framework Contract 'My Renovation Guidance' for Private Homes for a Period of 2 Years on Behalf of the City of Bruges. Description: For the Bruges territory, the intermunicipal company WVI operates the Energy House for the city of Bruges together with the city of Bruges. The City of Bruges is responsible for carrying out the basic tasks and WVI for MijnVerbouwLening. The basic task of energy houses is to get residents out to guide their operating area with all their questions about energy, energy saving, renovation and the possibilities regarding premiums and loans for this. This is done by providing information, providing a renovation and housing counter and offering home renovation advice. In the context of the reform of financing by the Flemish Government, it is determined that the part of renovation advice at home (formerly Neighborhood Premium, now My Renovation Guidance https://www.vlaanderen.be/een-huis-verbouwen/mijn-verbouwbegeleiding), will be handled entirely via the Energy House and no longer, as in the past, via Fluvius directly to all executors. For these reasons, the city of Bruges wants to increase the capacity to increase this renovation support for private individuals on its territory by appointing one external party. This concerns a framework agreement for the appointment of one external party that represents private individuals on the territory of the city Bruges will assist with the renovation of their home in the context of MVB Basis and MVB PV. A more detailed description is included in chapter 4 technical regulations. Category (CPV code): Structural engineering consultancy services (71312000). Published Date: 2025-12-22. Mandatory periodic inspections for certain specific technical installations are carried out by organizations, which are accredited (NBN EN/ISO/IEC 17020), by institutions recognized by legislation and approved by the competent Belgian authorities, for the field of control activities as an Approved Body (A.O.) and/or External Service for Technical Inspections (S.E.C.T). Other mandatory periodic checks, which must be carried out by a competent person designated by the owner of the technical installations, are carried out by organizations which are accredited and approved in the field of control activity. This procedure, divided into 2 lots, aims to conclude one or two framework contract(s) for a maximum duration of 4 (2+1+1) years, the objective of which is to cover all the services relating to periodic and regulatory checks of the electrical and technical installations of buildings occupied by the Secretariat in Brussels and surrounding areas, as well as checks on request and laboratory analyzes of samples taken from these buildings. Description: As part of the post-flood reconstruction/renovation of the city center and in particular the projects included in the portfolio submitted to FEDER 21-27 calls, a project to supply buildings with cold and heat using open geothermal energy was implemented. propose. At the center of this project is the energy renovation of the former Grand Bazar located on rue Crapaurue and its transformation into an administrative city. The installation of an open geothermal system in the city center (high density of inputs) in order to supply energy to the renovated building constitutes an example of innovation and adaptation of the City of Verviers. A first exploratory study contract, implementing a 6" drilling up to 177m, resulted in the installation of a piezometer (Pz1) and made it possible to identify sufficient potential reaching a minimum of 18 m³/h (limit of the structure) and estimated between 30-40m³/h. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: BRUSSELS AIRPORT COMPANY NV. Summary: Cleaning Services / Cleaning Services. Description: Cleaning is an essential service at Brussels Airport because of its great importance for the experience of our passengers. In recent years it has become clear that the hospitality aspect of cleaning is not just a trend, but a strategic one leverage to improve both passenger satisfaction and employee engagement. The tender consists of two lots and the aim is to conclude a framework agreement with one or two parties. The scope of the future both contracts includes all cleaning activities, including periodic and regular cleaning, specialized cleaning, interventions, interior window cleaning, the purchase of consumables, minor repairs, waste management and additional. These activities are carried out per plot by the same party. The difference lies in the zones themselves. If candidates participate in both lots, a synergy proposal will be requested in the tender. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: MUNICIPALITY OF ZELE. Summary: Renovation of the Old N47 Business Park - Preliminary Process and Preparation - Appointment of Engineering Office. Description: Context and reason The N47 industrial estate in Zele is one of the oldest industrial estates in the Dendermonde region and is the most important employment location within the municipality. With more than 100 established companies, the site plays a key role in the economic dynamics of Zele as an economic hub on the Ghent-Antwerp axis. Despite this important position, the business park suffers from a series of structural bottlenecks: outdated infrastructure, fragmented ownership structure, low image quality, poor spatial coherence, limited attention to sustainability and energy efficiency, a suboptimal mobility network, and a missing vision on park management. An integral redesign and redevelopment is therefore necessary to make the industrial estate future-proof and to evolve into a climate-neutral industrial estate. Purpose of the preliminary phase The preliminary phase is partly financed through a subsidy from VLAIO, and implements the Flemish Decree government of July 19, 2019 granting support for the (re)development of industrial estates. The preliminary phase aims to develop a concrete plan of action that is supported by the actors involved and that provides direction for the later reconstruction and the management of the site. Description: Project 20.484B/2 - Schaffen, Collector Schaffen Phase 2 - GOG Veldbeek. The works include the creation of a controlled flood area (GOG) on the Veldbeek (B3066) between Berkstraat and Waterstraat in Schaffen (Diest). The existing course of Veldbeek is partly being relocated. Upstream, part of the current course will be filled in and the bed will be shifted to create a meander. An overflow construction is provided at the outlet of the GOG with a squeeze with adjustable slide around it to adjust the flow rate. At the level of the overflow construction, the banks and the bottom of the watercourse are reinforced. A dike will be constructed between the Veldbeek and the Berkstraat and Waterstraat to retain the water in the area and to protect the roadway and to protect surrounding plots during peak discharges when the buffer capacity of the GOG is activated. In addition to this dike, the existing drainage ditch along the Waterstraat will be extended along the Berkstraat in order to drain the surface water. evacuate and connect to the Veldbeek. New barriers are being placed next to the dike. The existing pipe of the Veldbeek will be replaced by the construction of new tubes in the roadway with 2 wells and 2 end walls. This is also where the roadway becomes redesigned. The works include: • Breaking up existing sewerage; • Breaking up existing pavements; • Earthmoving according to current legislation (Vlarebo); • Excavating new watercourse bed; • Filling old waterbed.... input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: FARYS. Summary: Carrying out Road and Sewerage Works in Trompstraat on the Territory of the City of Halle.. Description: The present assignment concerns the construction of a separate sewerage system in part of the Kasteelbrakelsesteenweg, the Trompstraat and the Blekerijstraat. The DWA leadership starts at the Kasteelbrakelsesteenweg 534, follows the slope of the terrain and walks to Trompstraat. In Tompstraat, 2 side streets connect to the DWA system. The wastewater flows to the existing pumping station at the intersection of Blekerijstraat and Dokter Spitaelslaan. Between Kasteelbrakelsesteenweg and Trompstraat no. 33 an existing pipeline runs through grasslands. This will be relined and connected to the new DWA pipeline in Trompstraat. The RWA management also takes care of Kasteelbrakelsesteenweg 534. The RWA follows the terrain slope. In the Trompstraat the Villersbeek connected to the RWA. Further on, the flow of the Villersbeek is diverted via a pinch to the open bed near lot 83. A canal in Blekerijstraat is being reprofiled to buffer rainwater and allow it to infiltrate. Seen the narrow streets, a grout screen will have to be constructed spread across the route. To install the sewerage system, the current road surface will be completely demolished and restored to its original condition, subject to the current road widths and aanhorigheden. Category (CPV code): Construction work for pipelines, communication and power lines, for highways, roads, airfields and railways, flatwork (45230000). Published Date: 2025-12-16. Closing Date: 2026-02-02. Competition: ICB. Financier Name: Self Financed

input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: WATER-LINK. Summary: Construction of a Salaadweg Pumping Station. Description: A pumping station must be built at the port of Antwerp (Salaadweg, 2180 Antwerp). The function of this pumping station will be to pump purified wastewater from the Merksem sewage treatment plant from the pseudo shaft to the Voorgracht. Transporting WWTP water between the apparent duct and the fore-moat via a pumping system is necessary to maintain a hydraulic separation between the apparent duct and the fore-moat. The purpose of the assignment is the construction of the pumping station Salaadweg including supply pipe that connects the false shaft with the Salaadweg pumping station and the effluent pipe that connects the Salaadweg pumping station with the fore-moat. The works consist of the following parts: - Creating a link between the false shaft and the pumping station. - Execution of civil works and electromechanical installation. - Creating a link between the pumping station and the Voorgracht. - The installation of a high-voltage cabin to provide electrical power to the station. - It construction of an access road. Description: This assignment concerns the adaptation of the existing sewerage system at the recycling park in Lebbeke (D'Helst 2), with the aim of bringing the entire drainage of the site into compliance with current environmental legislation, in particular VLAREM II and the Rainwater ordinance of October 17, 2023. The evaluation of the existing situation shows that the rainwater from the pavements is currently not completely purified before discharge to the public DWA system. To comply with applicable environmental regulations and to enable the renewal of the environmental permit, the sewerage system is being technically adapted. The works do not involve an expansion of the existing infrastructure, but merely an optimization of the existing sewerage system and installing facilities for purification, buffering and delayed drainage of rainwater. Description: The assignment involves carrying out a geophysical survey of a sinkhole and its immediate surroundings, with the aim of: 1. Mapping the current geophysical condition, including: - locating cavities, fault zones and subsidence areas; - detection of current water-bearing openings; determination of the depth and size of underground structures. 2. Determining the cause of the leaching and subsidence, including: - localization of inflow and outflow zones of underground watercourses; - analysis of water flow and possible erosion or collapse mechanisms. 3. Formulating an initial advice, consisting of: - recommendations for stabilizing the current situation; - proposals for a structural and sustainable approach solution to the problem. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: UNIVERSITY OF LIÈGE (3P). Summary: Renovation of the Main Entrance of Building B31 and Restoration of the Work of Félix Roulin. Description: The market is part of the project to renovate the area around the main entrance of building B31, near Place des Orateurs. These areas are mainly occupied by the work of the artist Félix Roulin Law and Justice for Humanity , designed in 1982, like a circular amphitheater, whose stands seem to tilt towards the entrance to building B31. The work is made of massive blue stone and fits into the slope of the land. It includes a central sculpture and tiers which unfold in concentric arcs towards the entrance to the building. These stands have stair step heights, they also serve as access stairs. Over time, the stones broke and lost their non-slip nature, access to the building through the work has become dangerous. In 2015, temporary staircases with steel ramps and handrails were built above the work in order to secure circulation. This project concerns the restoration of the work, its adaptation for promote peripheral circulation, as well as the repair of the surroundings of the work and the main entrance to building B31. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: ATH. Summary: Ath Recre 01 - Design/Construction of Recreational Space and Youth Reception Center. Description: The Locomotives site, located behind Ath station, constitutes a pivotal space between the historic city center, the Dendre and the SNCB/TEC intermodal network. Currently occupied by parking lots, technical rooms and some equipment dispersed (resource center, river stopover, skate park), it presents a strong potential for urban and landscape requalification. This site is part of a dynamic of redeployment of the station district, initiated by the City of Ath as part of several development measures supported by the FEDER programs, the Walloon Recovery Plan and Urban Development. These interventions aim to reconnect the city to its waterway, to strengthen the attractiveness of the city center and to develop a living environment user-friendly and durable. The City of Ath thus aims to transform the so-called Locomotives site into a mixed activity hub, combining leisure, soft mobility, river tourism and facilities dedicated to youth. This urban reorganization aims in particular: • The landscape enhancement of the site and its opening onto the Dendre; • The redeployment of the marina with pontoons, harbor master's office and multi-purpose space that can accommodate a HORECA function; • The development of a recreational space and a reception center for young people; • The reinforced connection with the city center by improving access to the under-track tunnel. This site is part of a dynamic of redeployment of the station district, initiated by the City of Ath as part of several development measures supported by the FEDER programs, the Walloon Recovery Plan and Urban Development. These interventions aim to reconnect the city to its waterway, to strengthen the attractiveness of the city center and to develop a living environment user-friendly and durable. The City of Ath thus aims to transform the so-called Locomotives site into a mixed activity hub, combining leisure, soft mobility, river tourism and facilities dedicated to youth. This urban reorganization aims in particular: • The landscape enhancement of the site and its opening onto the Dendre; • The redeployment of the marina with pontoons, harbor master's office and multi-purpose space that can accommodate a HORECA function; • The development of a recreational space and a reception center for young people; • The reinforced connection with the city center by improving access to the under-track tunnel. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: INTERMUNICIPAL ASSOCIATION IDELUX PUBLIC PROJECTS. Summary: Project Authorship Mission for the Creation of Cycling Infrastructure in the Province of Luxembourg and in the Municipality of Lierneux.. Description: The purpose of this service contract is to be a project author with a view to the implementation of cycling infrastructure in the province of Luxembourg and in the Municipality of Lierneux. It is structured into three distinct lots. Each batch concerns a mission complete form of project author relating to the development of a specific section of cycle-pedestrian path. Each mission includes the following phases: sketch, preliminary project, application for planning permission (if applicable), project and preparation of the file execution, assistance in the analysis of work offers, monitoring, control and direction of the execution of the work, and site supervision. The sections concerned are geographically and technically independent, and are therefore each the subject of a batch separated. For each of the three lots, only the “sketch” phase is the subject of a firm tranche. The following phases are conditional tranches, the completion of which is subject to an express decision by the contracting authorities. Each batch can be separately assigned. The contracting authority reserves the right not to award one or more lots. Category (CPV code): Engineering-design services for traffic installations (71322500). Published Date: 2025-12-05.
